sanskrit_verse:
पितृयानो 'जवीथ्याश च यद अगस्त्यस्य चान्तरम् ।
तेनाग्निहोत्रिणो यान्ति स्वर्गकामा दिवं प्रति ॥
transliteration: pitṛyāno 'javīthyāś ca yad agastyasya cāntaram / tenāgnihotriṇo yānti svargakāmā divaṃ prati //
sph_interpretive_translation: Those who perform Agnihotra and follow the paths of Pitrs and the sages, including Agastya, traverse toward heaven desiring svarga.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows through ritual alignment with cosmic order
Causation arises from disciplined action aligned with Vedic injunctions
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by initiation and sustained practice
Restoration occurs via alignment with ancestral and celestial pathways
Consciousness alignment manifests through prescribed Vedic duties
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent performs Agnihotra AND maintains Pitryana path THEN svarga eligibility is activated
IF deviation in ritual observance THEN eligibility suspension UNTIL rectification
IF consciousness attunement verified THEN automatic svarga-path activation
IF ancestral debt acknowledged AND ritual discharge initiated THEN karmic pathway restoration
supreme_court_application: Supreme Court adjudicates based on verifiable ritual performance and lineage adherence; intent is irrelevant—only śāstric capacity and continuity determine eligibility.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality establishes svarga eligibility through direct observation of ritual fidelity. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures sequential spiritual ascent. Responsibility is proportional to initiation level. No punitive consequences arise—only natural karmic alignment.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Re-initiation into Agnihotra until śuddhi is achieved
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Acknowledgment of ancestral duty before tribunal
Capacity Restoration: Guided ritual repetition under qualified guru supervision
Integrity Reintegration: Public declaration of renewed commitment to Pitryana path
final_declaration: By the authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this dharma is restored. The path to svarga is not punitive but consequential. Consciousness alone is the final adjudicator.
